entities.summary: Jacqueline West is an American fashion and costume designer. Her accolades include a Costume Designers Guild Award, in addition to nominations for five Academy Awards and four BAFTA Awards. Her film credits include Quills (2000), The New World (2005), The Curious Case of Benjamin Button (2008), The Social Network (2010), The Tree of Life (2011), Argo (2012), The Revenant (2015), Dune (2021), its sequel Dune: Part Two (2024), and Killers of the Flower Moon (2023).
